# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- All identified implementations should be completed automatically without confirmation or additional questions, using sensible defaults.

## Project Guidelines
- Use the XAMPP MySQL connection string for JewelryStore: Server=localhost;Port=3306;Database=JewelryStoreDb;User=root;Password=.
- Use the brand name PrinciGold throughout the site, with the location shown as Gjilan.
- Render prices as formatted numeric euro values without Razor/string artifacts.
- Ensure the Hyr/login option functions correctly.
- Use smooth, polished animations in the PrinciGold e-commerce frontend, keeping them responsive and subtle rather than distracting.
- Create a responsive, more dynamic mobile frontend with subtle animations.
